shared_elements: human figure(s) rendered in low relief
upright slab-shaped field filled with figural carving
framing border enclosing the figural field
dense ornamental filler patterning around figures
vertical stacking of motifs in registers/zones
justification: Both surfaces show human figures in relief on an upright slab whose figural field is bounded by a border and filled with dense ornament in stacked zones, but this is about as generic as monumental figural relief gets. A depicts a narrative scene — a horse with rider above a sailing ship with rigging and crew, framed by continuous ribbon interlace — while B depicts a single frontal, richly costumed standing figure with a towering headdress and blocky sign-like panels, sharing neither the specific motifs (horse, boat, interlace) nor their relationships.
